  - Description: Small teams are given a basket of mystery ingredients and a time limit to prepare a dish together. Each team presents its dish, and the group votes on creativity and taste.
  - Objective: To build collaboration, communication, and trust while having fun outside of regular work tasks.
  - Location: Office kitchen or a local cooking school
  - Date: To be scheduled
  - Time: 2 hours, to be scheduled

Activity 6: Escape Room Challenge
  - Description: Teams work together to solve a series of puzzles and riddles within a set time limit to "escape" a themed room.
  - Objective: To strengthen critical thinking, division of tasks, and collaborative problem-solving under pressure.
  - Location: Local escape room venue
  - Date: To be scheduled
  - Time: 1 hour, to be scheduled
